newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - United News shares head for 750p.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - United News shares head for 750p.

text.p: Shares in publisher and information services group United News & Media Plc are on their way to clash with resistance at 750p, technical analysts said.

"There has been a short sharp correction (upwards) in the price since May (and) this has eliminated the large deviation from the (200 and 25 day) moving average trend lines," said Robin Griffiths, technical analyst at HSBC James Capel.
"There is a good chance that the positive pattern will resume (and) if so, then it will confirm that the long-term trend will take the price to higher levels," he added.
By 0800 GMT, United News shares were up 3-1/2p to 708-1/2.
By July the shares had retraced half the 240p gain made between the low point in October 1995 and this year's peak of 752p in May.
That 240p gain caused the difference between the stock's 200 and 25 day to widened to over 20 percent by June indicating an unstable share price and the shares consequently tumbled to 620p by June.
The recent share price pick-up has caused the moving averages to pull apart once more after reducing the deviation to two percent in August.

And to confirm the current bullish phase, analysts point to the stock's price-relative chart which shows the shares are now starting to catch up with the Allshare index after underperforming it by 13.8 percent between May and July.
